context_for_next_testing_agent: Odoo-style accounting system fully tested. Backend has 26 API tests covering: dashboard, chart of accounts CRUD, partners CRUD, taxes CRUD, journals CRUD, fiscal years CRUD, invoice creation/posting, payment registration, journal entry creation, and 8 report types. Frontend has 6 tabs (Overview, Invoicing, Payments, Entries, Reports, Config) all working. Config has 5 sub-tabs (Accounts, Partners, Taxes, Journals, Fiscal Years). Invoice workflow: Create -> Post -> Pay. All double-entry bookkeeping is correctly implemented.

backend_apis.GET /api/acc/dashboard: PASS - Returns all dashboard stats (cash, bank, receivable, payable, invoices, bills, entries, payments, monthly income/expense/profit)
backend_apis.GET /api/acc/accounts: PASS - Returns 47+ seeded accounts with code, name, type, balance
backend_apis.GET /api/acc/partners: PASS - Returns partners with receivable/payable totals
backend_apis.GET /api/acc/taxes: PASS - Returns 15+ seeded taxes (GST, IGST, TDS)
backend_apis.GET /api/acc/journals: PASS - Returns 9 journals with entry counts

frontend_tabs.Overview: PASS - Shows 8 stat cards + Monthly Summary bar chart + Balance Distribution pie chart + Income vs Expenses chart
frontend_tabs.Invoicing: PASS - Create invoice with partner selection and line items, Post/Cancel actions, Invoice/Bill toggle
frontend_tabs.Payments: PASS - Register payment with type/amount/journal selection, payment list with status
frontend_tabs.Entries: PASS - Shows auto-generated journal entries from invoices/payments with debit/credit columns
frontend_tabs.Reports: PASS - 8 report types all loading correctly (Trial Balance, P&L, Balance Sheet, General Ledger, Aged Receivables/Payables, Cash Flow, Tax Report)
frontend_tabs.Config: PASS - 5 sub-tabs (Chart of Accounts, Partners, Taxes, Journals, Fiscal Years) all with CRUD functionality

bug_fixed.root_cause: In create_invoice_move function (engine.py line 254), due_days was None when invoice_data.get('payment_terms_days', 30) returned None (because the key existed with None value), causing TypeError in timedelta(days=due_days)
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Changed to `due_days = invoice_data.get('payment_terms_days') or 30` to properly handle None values
